entries.title: Rising Warm Air and Cooling Cloud Box
entries.description: A transparent cube of air with colored spheres representing warm moist parcels rising, cooling as they ascend (color shifting), condensing into clustered semi-transparent droplets that grow, merge, and eventually fall as rain particles.
entries.seed: Rising Warm Air and Cooling Cloud Box: A transparent cube of air with colored spheres representing warm moist parcels rising, cooling as they ascend (color shifting), condensing into clustered semi-transparent droplets that grow, merge, and eventually fall as rain particles.

entries.title: Cloud Droplet Nucleation Chamber
entries.description: A clear vertical chamber where tiny dust particles (small gray spheres) float and attract surrounding water vapor particles (tiny blue dots), gradually forming larger semi-transparent droplets that detach from the dust and drift downward as rain.

entries.title: Mountain-Induced Rainfall (Orographic Lift)
entries.description: A moving stream of warm air particles (orange arrows) flows toward a 3D mountain, is forced upward along the slope, cools and condenses into a forming cloud layer on the windward side, then releases falling raindrops and casts a dry “rain shadow” on the leeward side.

entries.title: Cold Front Collision and Rain Band
entries.description: Two colored air masses (a blue cold-front wedge and a red warm-front slab) slide and collide, forcing the warm air upward where water vapor particles condense into a slanted band of cloud droplets that grow, merge, and fall as streaks of rain with trails.

entries.title: Microscopic Droplet Coalescence in a Cloud Slice
entries.description: Inside a semi-transparent white cloud volume, many small, slowly drifting droplets randomly collide, stick, and merge into larger droplets whose size is shown by radius and color, until heavy droplets detach and accelerate downward leaving faint motion trails.
